citations.claim: ADUSA Distribution converted its Chester NY DC on Elizabeth Drive from C&S on July 30, 2023: ~600K sq ft multi-temp + freezer, 350+ trailer spots, ~100 dock doors, ~65M cases/yr, serving Stop & Shop and Hannaford.
Corroborates the Chester DC as part of Ahold Delhaize USA's self-distribution buildout, taken over from C&S, serving Stop & Shop and Hannaford.

verification.rationale: Confirmed current ADUSA self-distributed multi-temperature cross-dock serving Stop & Shop and Hannaford; insourced from C&S Aug 2023, active hiring at the site. Specs match Tier-1 release exactly. No closure/WARN signal.

fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully fenced (chain-link confirmed along the south dock face and the Elizabeth Drive frontage in multiple Street View frames). Truck flow is consolidated onto a perimeter ring road that breaks the fence at a single paved apron on the north frontage off Elizabeth Drive. Controlled access is strongly implied for a fenced ~600K sq ft cold-chain DC, but the private ring road has no Street View coverage and the public-road panos are set back across a wide lawn, so a barrier arm could not be directly resolved. Called true on the fenced perimeter + single consolidated access point.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard-booth structure resolvable at the entrance throat in satellite z20-z21; the north entry area reads as office + employee/visitor parking. Likely kiosk / app check-in for an automated cold-chain DC. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true because truckGate=true and no guard shack was visible; consistent with kiosk/call-box/app check-in. Pairs with guardShack uncertainty.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long continuous dock banks on the south face (trailers backed in end-to-end, SV-b) and a second bank on the north/interior face; web release states ~100 dock doors. Counted band 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yard on the east side (rows of unhitched trailers, ss07_dc_z18 / ss07_east_z18) plus a south overflow row; web release states 350+ trailer spots. Band 50+.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Estimate ~280 trailers visible across the east drop yard, south dock line, and NW lot in the captured imagery; honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: ADUSA/C&S release states yard has 350+ trailer spots; used as capacity.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~95 doors; corroborated by the 'nearly 100 dock doors' figure in the ADUSA Aug-2023 release.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Wide paved entrance apron; estimated 2 inbound lanes, low confidence (no ground view of the throat).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron and large open paved frontage off Elizabeth Drive give ample room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep approach from the Elizabeth Drive fence break to the dock faces; can hold 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large interior paved yard between the gate apron and the dock faces serves as inside staging.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the east property edge (ss07_east_z18) but no spur enters the property; not rail-served.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: As a cross-dock both inbound and outbound move through the same dock banks; no clearly separate ship vs receive cluster. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park outside the village of Chester, NY, surrounded by open land, wetlands, and a quarry; judged Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~43 acres from the traced perimeter polygon (building + east drop yard + south yard inside the fence).
